note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary literals and a base config reference. It has no functions, classes, or callable code. It configures FreeAnchorRetinaHead for object detection on COCO with a ResNet-50 FPN backbone.
summarize_config: summarize the freeanchor_r50_fpn_1x_coco config which sets FreeAnchorRetinaHead with 80 classes and SmoothL1Loss
review_bbox_head_config: review the FreeAnchorRetinaHead bbox_head config with anchor generator strides and delta XYWH bbox coder
review_anchor_generator: review the AnchorGenerator config with octave_base_scale 4 and 3 scales per octave
review_optim_wrapper: review the optim_wrapper config that clips gradients with max_norm 35 and L2 norm
review_loss_bbox: review the SmoothL1Loss bbox loss config with beta 0.11 and loss_weight 0.75
